what: Detection AP and tracking metrics recomputed from the saved raw detections and tracks of both profiles, and compared number by number with the archived metrics_test.json and metrics_dev.json.

evaluator.labels: EMT labels, in a folder the pipeline never reads

result_labels.archived: the metrics files shared with the predictions since Part 1
result_labels.reproduced_by_owner: Task 1, this record. Every number identical for both profiles and both splits.
result_labels.reproduced_independently: tracking metrics on the full test set, by A1Prep (docs/task1-artifact-verification.md); detection AP has not been recomputed by anyone else, because the raw detections were first shared on 20 November 2026, in the zips listed here

commands.test: python -m tools.vision_evaluate --pred-dir predictions-<profile> --labels-root <EMT_LABELS_ROOT> --split test --recordings video_204647 video_122233 video_125233 video_155425 video_160325 --out <test.json>
commands.dev: python -m tools.vision_evaluate --pred-dir predictions-<profile> --labels-root <EMT_LABELS_ROOT> --split train --recordings video_054907 video_174340 --out <dev.json>

recording_order.why: pycocotools breaks ties between equal detection scores by input order, so AP reproduces exactly only with the archived order

shared_tracks: 15 of the 16 shared tracks files are frozen replays whose provenance names the sha256 of the detections they were made from (replayed_from); the fine-tuned video_054604 file came from the live run, and is tied to its detections by the replay below

comparisons.inputs: the run folders the archived metrics were made from
